prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1120; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed two passenger vehicles with front-end and right-side damage consistent with a side impact at a controlled intersection. Driver 1 stated that they were turning left across the eastbound lanes when the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was traveling straight through the intersection. Driver 2 stated that the signal had changed to green for their direction and that they did not see Driver 1 turn until impact. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was seated in the rear and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and said the pain began immediately after the collision. Driver 1 was conscious, cooperative, and able to exit the vehicle with assistance. Both vehicles were towed from the scene. Witness statements were requested, and the signal timing record for the intersection has been requested from the city traffic department for further review.
